title: Cora Mends the Torn Corner
youtube_title: Cora Mends the Torn Corner | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness includes caring for a book so the next reader finds it whole.
summary: Cora notices a small tear in a rabbit picture book. She and Ada hinge it with a soft paper strip, read the page gently, and leave the mended book ready for friends.
